reviews.text: The font is too tiny on iPad.

reviews.title: Where is Dark Mode???
reviews.text: This game is awesome, but desperately needs a dark mode! Please implement!!!

reviews.title: Disappointed !
reviews.text: I’ve been doing this brain training for quite a few years now ( free) and I’m sad to say I miss having only two games now instead of four. I don’t want to pay to upgrade , Thankyou., but it saddens me that I can’t do the same as before Yours sincerely S Jordan

reviews.title: Glitched
reviews.text: Thought this was great at first, then paid for premium. The games can be good apart from a few that literally don’t make any sense. Especially the word games. I’ve triple checked to make sure it’s not me and it’s definitely not. Then you have this whole stats thing which is honestly broken. How can I always be above 87% of people yet my skills from playing each individual game, impact my overall score and make it lower than what it originally was? Despite me actually scoring higher and being faster than whatever percentage they say? I wish this part was fixed because it doesn’t make sense at all. Each improvement I make as well on each of the games as it shows me a little graph higher than the last time I played but yet again my overall brain score doesn’t improve? Fix your game. Absolute waste of money tbh.

reviews.title: Used to love - now a paywall
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this app, re-downloaded it today to find that when I try and play the daily workout it doesn’t let me proceed without trying pro? It always used to be that you could play the daily game selection, and then anything else you’d have to watch an ad to unlock which was fine, but now it’s not even letting me do the daily selection without pro?

reviews.title: Unplayable without Purchase
reviews.text: I redownloaded this app after not playing for a few years, and I wondered why I never played again. I was rudely reminded when everything except a few daily games were locked behind strict paywalls. The games themselves are great and really fun, but locking everything behind a paywall is so annoying. Not everything needs a subscription.

reviews.title: No help
reviews.text: I need a refund on this app. I have emailed support multiple times regarding the streaks, the changing email or anything really and I have received 0 respond. Its like they don’t really care about anything once you purchase the yearly membership. And no, automatic responds without a follow up is not a respond.

reviews.title: Free version is useless
reviews.text: The free version is useless. When an ad comes up it never lets you exit out of it and do the free brain training. I don’t mind watching ads but even when you’ve watched it and force close the app, it immediately returns to an ad when you reopen it

reviews.title: Game performances
reviews.text: The scores are not accurate. Sometimes you do better on all games but there’s no change in score

reviews.title: Unacceptable changes
reviews.text: I have been using Peak for many years and suddenly it has changed. The app is not working and keeps stalling.  The sign-in is a nightmare and then the games are restricted. Achievements have disappeared with some of my games at novice level which is nonsense. I will try it again in a few days and if it is not restored and my account updated to show I’ve paid, etc. then I will stop my subscription and delete the app.  It has been a very frustrating morning and I have wasted hours trying to use it as normal.

reviews.title: Censorship
reviews.text: I wanna know why Israel has been removed from the list of Middle Eastern countries

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: Pretty basic stuff, lack of variety in some categories for the ‘brain training’. Majority of the exercises are far too simple. Also, consecutively achieving perfect scores or ‘you’re better than 99% of the people bla bla bla” appears to have no impact on increasing your supposed Peak brain score. I regret paying for this product, been a month, no noticeable improvements.

reviews.title: Don’t take the tests
reviews.text: Nowhere does it say you have to pay to receive your results until you’ve already done the 10 minute test. Pmo

reviews.title: After more than a decade of use…not recommended for anyone with mental health issues.
reviews.text: I have used this app for more than a decade. I will be blunt. This app messes with your head. When you win you ‘might’ get a point. When you loose…you will ALWAYS loose points. If you watch the stats, when you loose one game it will go down. If you win you don’t always earn a point , so it stays the same. In life you can’t ‘unlearn’ something. But in this expensive game you get penalized for loosing, and will not necessarily rise if you’re winning. It plays mind games with your head. Not recommended for anyone with mental health issues.

reviews.title: Eyestrain
reviews.text: Too small fonts of in instructions. Bad training for my eyes. Not fun

reviews.title: Great games but terrible Pro update experience
reviews.text: Multiple attempts to upgrade to the Pro version resulted in multiple charges to my Apple account and no easy way to get help for this buggy app. Finally found a Help option buried here, waiting for response to my email. I cannot recommend this app until they fix this problem.

reviews.title: Major Bugs
reviews.text: There were zero bigs in the two years I have had this, now that they forced an "update" to fix all the bugs that did not exist, it consistently crashes numerous times per one game.  Makes me believe the update was for data mining and I will delete despite buying the app
